title: SFPD Arrests Suspect for Selling Drugs at Outside Lands Music Festival in Golden Gate Park - NewsBreak
text: SAN FRANCISCO — San Francisco Police announced the arrest of a suspect accused of selling illegal narcotics during the Outside Lands Music Festival in Golden Gate Park. On Friday, August 8, 2025, at around 3:40 p.m., officers from the SFPD Honda Unit were patrolling Golden Gate Park and surrounding neighborhoods when they responded to a report of a man selling drugs near Fulton Street and 26th Avenue. Officers, along with U.S. Park Rangers, located an adult male matching the description. “After a brief struggle, officers detained the male subject without further incident,” police said. The suspect was identified as 25-year-old Miles Vivirito of Frazier Park, California. Police said they found suspected illegal narcotics on Vivirito and in his vehicle. “A photo of the evidence accompanies this news release,” SFPD stated. Vivirito was booked into San Francisco County Jail on multiple charges, including three counts of possession of suspected ecstasy (MDMA) for sale, possession of ketamine for sale, possession of LSD for sale, resisting arrest, and parole violation. SFPD credited the Honda Unit, U.S. Park Rangers, event staff, and concert security for helping identify and apprehend Vivirito. “The SFPD Honda Unit, along with all other on-duty officers, were instrumental in keeping the public safe during the Outside Lands Music Festival,” the department said.
